post.summary: Gets a short-lived access token for applications using OpenID Connect (OIDC) to access the Conjur API.
post.description: Use the OIDC Authenticator to leverage the identity layer provided by OIDC to authenticate with Conjur. For more information see [the documentation](https://docs.conjur.org/Latest/en/Content/OIDC/OIDC.htm).
